brief:
The Quincy Institute reports that Donald Trump stated the United States would reduce financial assistance to Israel, framing the decision around Israeli conduct in Gaza. Trump's remarks signaled a shift in how the incoming administration might calibrate support for Israel, though specifics on the scale and timeline of any aid reduction remained unclear.

The statement marked an unusual break from Trump's previous strong backing of Israel during his first term and his recent campaign messaging. His comment suggested conditions could be attached to future U.S. military and economic support, contingent on Israeli actions in the Gaza conflict.
title: Trump says U.S. will cut aid to Israel over Gaza conduct
